name: WuxianPi Browser Tools
summary: Optional Pi tools for controlling a connected WuxianPi Browser Host.
description: Adds browser_operation and app_action as an assistant-selectable Pi extension. The tools call the stable WuxianPi Runtime Browser Host HTTP API and are never enabled globally.

contributions.name: Browser Host Tools
contributions.description: Registers browser_operation and app_action for assistants that explicitly enable this contribution.
